title: preflight release scrapbook
content:
Purpose: scratchpad for tomorrow's preflight + hour-by-hour reminders. This is my single page live notes during the cutover. Not a polished runbook — copy important items into the official runbook after the fact.

Top-level goals
- Ship v2026-03-12: infra + model catalog updates. Minimal downtime target: <3m for API-critical paths.
- Ensure graceful fallback to model-legacy if new model OOMs or latency regresses.
- Backports and hotfixes applied to dedicated pools before traffic migration.

Quick status checks (first pass, before 07:00 PT)
- [ ] Smoke prod-metrics pipeline (prometheus -> grafana dashboards up)
- [ ] Confirm deploy tags exist: release/candidate, release/rc-2026-03-12
- [ ] Verify artifact integrity: sha256sum on model tarball matches CI artifact
- [ ] SRE on-call: @aria (sleeping until 06:30 PT), backup: @jonah

Backport / cherry-pick list (local notes)
- ui/fix-embeddings-path: PR #1092 -> needs cherry to release/candidate (jenkins job: cherryback-1092)
- runtime/kv-cache-fix: PR #1107 -> only on dedicated pools; patch branch: rb/kv-cache-1107
- metrics/label-fix: small change; low risk, include in post-cutover patch if time

Hotfix candidates to hold locally (do not push unless triggered)
- revert-compile-opt: revert commit 8f3a2b if kernel selection error appears
- patch: increase max-batch-size for T4 (config: /etc/redwood/batching.yaml)

Communications + who to ping
- Slack channel: #releng-cutover (pin this doc link)
- Escalation: page @oncall-sre -> if API error rate > 5% for 5m after migration
- Customer notice: product-ops -> pre-draft sent, hold for final green

Commands I always forget — local copy
- Check service health all regions (k8s): kubectl -n redwood get pods -l app=api --field-selector=status.phase!=Running
- Force rollout: kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deploy/api --selector=rel=release-candidate
- Tail logs for gateway (last 200 lines): gcloud logging read "resource.type=k8s_container AND labels.k8s-pod/app=gateway" --limit 200 --project=redwood-prod
- Swap traffic (canary->primary): ./ops/switch-traffic --from canary --to primary --strategy gradual --steps 4
- Manual fallback: ./ops/fallback-model --target model-legacy --reason "latency regression" --ticket RELENG-4321

Observability quick checks (first 2 minutes after traffic shift)
- latency.p95[api/generate] < 450ms (global)
- token-cost/unit not > 1.4x baseline in last 10m
- error.rate[5m] < 0.5% for token-generation endpoints
- KV cache hit ratio >= 35% for default routes (if drops, consider increasing cache size)

Rollback plan (fast)
- Criteria: p95 latency > 750ms OR error.rate > 3% sustained for 3m OR model OOMs observed
- Steps:
  1) Stop ingress to candidate pool: ./ops/stop-ingress --pool candidate
  2) Switch traffic back to stable: ./ops/switch-traffic --from candidate --to stable --immediate
  3) Re-open incident ticket: RELENG-4321 (assign to self), add logs+grafana links
  4) Notify customers in product-ops channel and #releng-cutover

Post-cutover follow-ups (notes to self)
- Verify canary logs for 1hr, then promote metrics retention for the runby dashboard
- File PR to add missing healthcheck to model loader (noticed occasional 503s during warmup)
- Add a one-line summary to weekly releng sync + link to any hotfix PRs

Open questions / TODO (during downtime I scribble answers here)
- Will the dedicated pools respect the new batching config without restart? Test on staging tonight.
- Is the latency regression observed last week tied to kv-cache eviction threshold? Reproduce with long context input in staging.

Short timeline (local timestamps PT)
- 05:30 alarm (start warmup scripts)
- 06:00 preflight meeting @ #releng-cutover (15m) — quick green checks, owner confirmations
- 07:00 begin canary (5% traffic) — monitor 10m, if green increment to 25%
- 07:20 ramp to 50% (if green at 25% for 10m)
- 07:40 full 100% if all checks pass
- +60m post-mortem notes and hand off to oncall rotation

Random notes to self (messy):
- Remember to stash local debug flags before running switch traffic (./ops/stash-debug)
- If warmup time > 90s, consider pre-warming with warmup-enabled flag (./ops/warmup --parallel 4)
- Reconfirm KMS access for private deployments before pushing private-only models

End of page — will append live notes during cutover.

Live entry (03/12/2026 07:12 PT): 
- Canary started at 07:01; p95 = 412ms, error spikes 0.6% at 07:04 for 90s then normalized. Watching for second window.
- Jonah acked readiness, Aria still on-call.

(transfer anything important to shared runbook after cutover)
